justifications.unit: Unit tests drive send, publish, batch and FIFO paths against substituted SQS and SNS clients, including the supplied and generated message id and the FIFO deduplication id.
justifications.guard: Guard tests cover the constructor and method null checks.
justifications.integration: Integration tests drive queue send, FIFO send with group and deduplication ids, SNS publish and the message id and type attributes against a LocalStack SQS/SNS emulator; the remaining lines are the batch result collection, which currently throws on a fully successful batch (#2799), and the exception branches that need a failing broker.
justifications.contract: Contract tests run the real publisher against LocalStack and assert the IAmazonSQSMessagePublisher contract (Right with the broker id, Left with a stable code instead of throwing, type and id attributes); the batch send path is uncovered pending #2799, where a fully successful batch currently returns Left.

EncinaAmazonSQSOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults and validation

EncinaAmazonSQSOptionsValidator.cs.reason: Internal IValidateOptions validator; guard and property invariants are covered on the core EndpointValidator (#852)

justifications.integration: Integration tests register the package with a LocalStack queue URL under AllowInsecureHttp and AllowLocalEndpoints, so validation and the relaxed-endpoint warning run; the failure branches are covered by the unit flag.

Health/AmazonSQSHealthCheck.cs.reason: Health check with mockeable service dependencies

justifications.integration: Integration tests run ListQueues against LocalStack for the healthy result and against a closed port for the unhealthy result; the non-OK status and AmazonSQSException branches need a broker that answers with an error.
justifications.contract: Contract tests run the real health check against LocalStack and assert the IEncinaHealthCheck name, tags and healthy status.

IAmazonSQSMessagePublisher.cs.reason: Interfaces have no implementation to test

justifications.integration: Integration tests build the provider with ValidateOnBuild and ValidateScopes and pre-registered LocalStack clients, so the options, publisher and health check registrations run; the package's own client-construction lambdas (lines 50-66) stay integration-uncovered because the fixture clients win through TryAdd.
